B0745BYF7F.title: Really large capacity but outside gets VERY hot

MINUS SIDE: It's VERY large - measure your space before buying. The top gets REALLY, REALLY hot when in use - not good if in reach of…

The only thing is to be careful with the glass door - it will 'drop' the entire way to the counter as it doesn't have a hinge or any stop to prevent it from slamming all the way down.

Overall this is a great concept -- good volume, easy to use -- but at least our unit is a poor performer.

B08145LJPJ.title: just what I wanted, perks 30 cups in short ...

B08145LJPJ.title: Holds up well under constant use

The only reason we had to buy another one is because someone stole the previous urn, which was identical and had been in operation for several years.

B08145LJPJ.title: Good coffee

B08145LJPJ.title: Event hit.

B09FZMC5KK.title: In love!

Corn on the cob and chicken to be batter pan-fried for the KFC ‘secret’ to crispy moist fried chicken. Old style pressure cooking is messy, noisy, a smidge scary, and steamer heavy cumbersome. The Duo is an effective space-saving pressure cooker. Haven’t tried any other feature except pressure cooking. I’m happy with for the reasonably sized family meal.

B09FZMC5KK.title: Bought as a gift. My son’s family loves it!!
B09FZMC5KK.comment: Bought as a gift. My son’s family loves it!!

If you are like me and only cook white rice...you hit the big orange start button and then come back in an hour... yep ..it does take a bit longer. So you pay a little more, and wait a little more while it cooks. And you get absolutely perfect rice every single time again, perfect and every time. Rice comes out moist and loose with no clumping. This is a well made product with very sturdy looking parts and looks like it will last a long time.

B09WJJSRFC.comment: Does a great job of cleaning all our tile floors. Quiet and easy to use

B09WJJSRFC.title: Great scrubber and cleaner
B09WJJSRFC.comment: Wow!! Very impressed!! Very light weight and easy to move. Tanks fill and empty easily. Did a great job on my tile and grout. Wish the cord was a little longer, but certainly not a deal breaker. Floors were washed and dried quickly.

B09WJJSRFC.title: Miracle Worker !
B09WJJSRFC.comment: We have 5 dogs and a pet pig, our kitchen floors and bathroom tile always felt like it had a film that my mop would never get off... I was so fed up with hands and knees scrubbing I researched and purchased this instantly. The shipping was so fast ! So easy to start using out of the box and it works miracles ! We have wonderfully clean floors all the time, I would recommend to everyone !

B09WJJSRFC.title: I have 2 dogs 5 cats my floors are so clean now
B09WJJSRFC.comment: The way it pick up the dirty water

B09WJJSRFC.title: Love it while it lasts because they usually don’t last long
B09WJJSRFC.comment: Less than year and mine died but when it was working I LOVED it!!!! The motor goes. I’m going to buy another one - different manufacturer this next time to see but. I was over the moon happy while it did run and devastate when it stopped. I used it on terrazzo floors and it made them bright and shiny. Much better job than the regular mop.

B09WJJSRFC.title: Great for elderly or other mobility impaired persons.
B09WJJSRFC.comment: This machine is great for the elderly or other mobility impaired persons, no mops or mop buckets to deal with. The water canisters are not heavy and attach and detach easily. It handles easily, tipped back on the wheels. The latches are relatively easy for arthritic hands to operate. Finally someone got the cord length right. Assembly of the long handle is very easy, just remove the long handle screw, insert the handle and re-install the screw. A medium size Phillips screwdriver is all the tools needed. The Hoover cleaning solution seems to be an excellent product. This is almost as good as a floor machine buffer for vinyl floor tile. I was surprised and impressed. Having cleaned floors…

B078W71CCN.title: Some people have a dog for picking up food crumbs; I have Mr. Belvedere.
B078W71CCN.comment: This was the best investment I made all year. I named him Mr. Belvedere. Mr. Belvedere cleans the house starting at 9:30 a.m. - I come home, dump out his bin and enjoy the clean floor. Some people have a dog for picking up food crumbs; I have Mr. Belvedere. If you're on the fence about a Roomba, get off the fence. Also he keeps me honest - since you have to pick up stuff or you come home to Mr. Belvedere eating your laptop cables.

B078W71CCN.title: For me it looks more like a mechanical brush rolling around
B078W71CCN.comment: I am not sure this is a "vacuum" cleaner. For me it looks more like a mechanical brush rolling around. I do not think it sucks any dust. There is a strong smell of dust and particles flying all over in the room after this tool finishes cleaning.It does not pick up small dog's hair or small feathers or tiny pieces of wood. It rolls right over it and nothing happens. Schedule doesn't work. Each time I have to start it manually. Container for the trash is too small, it can only keep a handful of trash. I have to clean it after every use. Rotating brush is small too. In general this tool looks like a toy. Regular vacuum cleaner does a much better job cleaning.

B078W71CCN.title: Works great.
B078W71CCN.comment: I don't run my Roomba every day, but I run it when needed and it works great. It gets under the bed and picks up all the dog hair. Because I have two yellow labs and they shut a lot I sometimes need to change the filter mid-vacuuming. That being said, my Roomba vacuums three rooms at a time. I'm glad I bought it. If I could change only one thing, I would make the collection area larger to handle more of the dog here.

B078W71CCN.title: Great Vacuum
B078W71CCN.comment: Best vacuum ever! mainly because I don't have to do a thing! My friend has a different brand, and he's always telling how it get's lost, get stuck, or is leaving marks on his trim. I don't have this problem. I have mine set up to run automatically at 7am, EVERY DAY. I've had it about 2 months now, and no issues. (I have two boxers that shed all the time, I have tile, wood and shag carpet rugs that it cleans) Now if they were to make a washer/dryer/folder machine, I'd be in heaven!! :) Was this review helpful? If so, please click the helpful button and help me stand out in all these reviews. Thanks!

B078W71CCN.title: Great little vacuum.
B078W71CCN.comment: Great price. Great vacuum. I love my iRobot Roomba 650 . I hope it lasts.

B078W71CCN.title: Was excited to get this.
B078W71CCN.comment: I loved the value, was excited to get this for my hard wood floors, it cleans great, however it seems to miss some areas and has a hard time finding it way back to the docking station. Have found it on top of my floor fan more than once dead. We close all the doors and only run it in the living/kitchen/ family room, not sure if its to big of an area around 700 square feet.

B078W71CCN.title: Super Satisfied Family with Fur Baby
B078W71CCN.comment: Love, love, love our Rooby. We run her every day to keep up with our shedding Corgi. Every day on our main level of our split level house (carpet & hardwood). Then we alternate days for the upstairs (carpet) and downstairs (carpet & tile). This was just what we needed to keep up. I have seen the horror stories of roombas running over pet accidents. Our dog is very good but we are not risking it so I just start her in the morning before I start work or whatever the day is bringing on. I typically work from home. Otherwise the kids can start her. We clean her out before each time. It is very simple. Even when the brushes need cleaned, it is simple. I had researched & done my homework before…

B078W71CCN.title: Awesome device - Just keep it clean (Especially with dog hair)
B078W71CCN.comment: I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE this machine. We have 2 dogs and hardwood floors. That makes for a daily vacuum chore. This little machine just runs around and picks up all the fine dog hair and dirt without issue. You just have to make sure that you keep it clean. We found that after a week of vacuuming, you have to take a pair of tweezers and get the tangled dog hair out of the front wheel. Otherwise, it spins in circles and doesn't clean properly. I would also recommend getting a spare accessories kit (the one with the extra filters and brushes) so you can keep the others washed and have the spares to rotate them while drying. We are not OCD about cleaning but this little thing makes a daily chore a…

B07B65CXL9.title: Not worth the money
B07B65CXL9.comment: The vacuum does pick up dirt and pet hair well. However the charge lasts for barely 20 minutes (one room if you’re lucky) and takes 3.5 hours to recharge. So what’s the point? Should come with an optional electrical plug. Also, need to remove the stick part to empty the bucket and the emptying mechanism jams up. Much poorer quality than previous versions.

B07B65CXL9.title: Not worth the money
B07B65CXL9.comment: This vacuum is only effective when used on my Ruggable area rug. It picks up only 60% of the debris on hard floor surfaces, I have to sweep and use a dusting cloth when working on hardwood or tile. The suction is so poor that I cannot get 2 dead bees out of the track on my balcony door.

B07B65CXL9.title: BUY IT!!!
B07B65CXL9.comment: The best vacuum hands down that i have ever used!!!! I absolutely love it so much!

B07B65CXL9.title: This is a seriously great vacuum
B07B65CXL9.comment: I've heard for years that Dyson makes the best vacuum cleaners. I've tended to ignore the hype. I have owned several of the "best" vacuums over the years, having paid 100s of dollars for various brands. I thought I would give this a try and I'm glad I did. It's no big deal to vacuum anymore. No cords, easy to clean, etc. Not quite as lightweight as I would have preferred but it's not too bad either. I am so impressed with this Dyson product! Makes me sorry I ever bought a Roomba at all, which frankly is great for cleaning under beds and couches but other than those things, is just about worthless.

B07B65CXL9.title: Dyson for life
B07B65CXL9.comment: Upgraded from the V6 to the V10 for less than I paid for V6 years ago and the V6 still worked great. Gifted the V6 to a friend that still had to deal with a cord and we both couldn’t be happier. The new dirt emptying system is an impressive improvement to keep the dirt only going into the trash bag and not flying around. I am very happy with this vacuum

B07B65CXL9.title: Makes vacuuming easy!
B07B65CXL9.comment: Works really well on carpet, and is very light to carry. Not sure if I will mount it on the wall though.

B07B65CXL9.title: doesnt scratch hardwood floor, low battery life, heaviness causing pain
B07B65CXL9.comment: It does not scratch hardwood floors. Suction power is good. But not advisable for prolong period of time usage due to heaviness and causing you hand, arm and shoulder pain. Battery power is not good as you need to charge it after 2-3 min usage.

B07B65CXL9.title: HASSLE
B07B65CXL9.comment: The V10 is GREAT in every way but one. When dumping the dust you must disconnect the main telescopic rod from the housing unit to empty. This is a pain in the hindquarters. The V6 empties far easier with no disconnecting involved. If I had realized this, I would have bought another V6. Dyson cordless vacs are GREAT and we use it daily. I dread emptying it everytime.

B0BRKL1F36.title: Good concept but has its flaws.
B0BRKL1F36.comment: **Update on my below review. One of the reasons I continue to buy Eufy products is their customer service. After my review they reached to me looking to resolve any issue. They provided a refund and requested I keep the vacuum. They said they will keep my feedback in mind on future product development. Can’t ask for more then that.** I’m a fan of Eufy products so when I saw this launch I wanted to give it a try. My main goal was to use it for small clean ups in my car. It’s a decent vacuum but has a big flaw. The motor fan is pointing downwards. So if you have an area you are trying to clean up it is basically blowing the mess away while you try to vacuum. A bit shocking this wasn’t…

B0BRKL1F36.title: Great little vacuum for an RV
B0BRKL1F36.comment: We often Glamp off-grid in our RV, so electricity is at a premium. I've been looking for a USB vac, and saw this one on sale.... so took the chance. Works great, and looks terrific! Battery life isn't for extended use, but it's plenty to do a quick floor vac of all the little things that get tracked in. Not intended to replace a full size vacuum of course! But it works to stretch that out. The cup is tiny!... but it's amazing how much debris it holds. It's actually perfect for what we need, and super easy to clean out (so I do it after every use). Great purchase. (in the pictures, it's the black 'bottle' looking item behind the small plant... looks nice on the counter and has a small…

B0BRKL1F36.title: Doesn't Sweep Up Well
B0BRKL1F36.comment: I have bought a lot of Anker products because I think they have quality products so I purchased the handheld vacuum with high expectations. I was disappointed in the handheld vacuum for several reasons - - It charges with an USB charger rather than a wall charger. - It does not pick up debris well and at times it seems as though it blows it around the room. - The battery life is short (under 15 minutes) so you have to wait hours for it to recharge to continue to use it. - It is lightweight but the weight is heavy at the end of it so it is not comfortable to use it. I would not recommend it. I was so unhappy with the product performance that I returned it for a refund.

B0BRKL1F36.title: I love this little vacuum but...
B0BRKL1F36.comment: We purchased this mini vac for our RV which has a central vac system but the central vac is a hassle to drag out from under the bed for small clean ups. The Eufy works great but after only a couple times using it, it now only charges up to 2 of the 3 lights on the side. I have no idea why and hope that Eufy will address this issue since others have posted the same experience with theirs.

B0BRKL1F36.title: Tiny but mighty
B0BRKL1F36.comment: It's perfect for everything. It picks up those little messes quickly and quietly in comparison to other handheld vacuums. It's a must-have for your house and the car. Oh, I forgot to mention it uses the same method as a cell phone to charge.

B0BRKL1F36.title: Pretty vaccum and useful
B0BRKL1F36.comment: The design is lovely and it is very useful for small pickups in tight spaces. The exhaust is in the wrong position for some issues as it blows where you want to pick up junk. You must hold it vertically. The trash cup does not sit tight enough in the tube to protect the motor from dirt. But, the customer service is terrific and very responsive. They sent me extra trash cups so that I could replace them more often to protect the motor. I have several other Anker/Eufy products and they are all very reliable.

B0BRKL1F36.title: Great Handy Vacuum
B0BRKL1F36.comment: I've read reviews that say the filter doesn't work well, and I haven't had mine long enough to know about that. But so far, the filter seems to fit well - it catches dust and pet hair. The size of the vac is terrific - doesn't take up much space. And i love that you just press the button and it stays on - no more holding it down to keep suction on. I'm pleased, so far!

B0BRKL1F36.title: Super powerful for the size
B0BRKL1F36.comment: This thing is the bomb. It has solid sucking power and is steady for the duration of use until low battery. The only downside is the power button is right where you want to place your thumb while in use so I turn it off sometimes by accident.

B0BG3L9JKH.title: A yes on all points!
B0BG3L9JKH.comment: This unit is outstanding! My body is hypersensitive to allergens and this cleans the air in my bedroom so well. It is also beautifully quiet plus attractive in design.

B0BG3L9JKH.title: No more sneezing and sniffling inside
B0BG3L9JKH.comment: I bought this because a reviewer said they used it to survive living in a mold infested apartment and I figured if it could make that livable our air quality situation would be a breeze. Within a day no more musty smell or respiratory issues. I will try to find that reviewer and thank them.

B0BG3L9JKH.title: Honeywell is a trusted name
B0BG3L9JKH.comment: Good unit. Runs quietly and does the job

B0BG3L9JKH.title: Cheaply made but work great!
B0BG3L9JKH.comment: So the purification function of these is truly great. Just having them on for a few days I notice the difference in my home’s air quality. However, Honeywell, what is with the VERY CHEAP quality of these? I ordered 1 large and 2 medium and the stickers for the buttons are all misaligned, and on the large one, only one side of the filter cover with ‘click ‘ into place. It’s such a large box to return and is working fine, so I kept it. Very cheap looking in every way. I’ve hidden them in corners where they won’t be seen but will still be super functional. They really need to revamp how cheaply these are made. Ugh.

B0BG3L9JKH.title: Excellent and quiet filtration
B0BG3L9JKH.comment: Excellent and quiet filtration. I had the older model monstrous size Honeywell and it was too noisy to have it on during sleep. This one is quieter and effective. Definitely would purchase another one if needed.

B0BG3L9JKH.title: Consumer Reports Recommended Model
B0BG3L9JKH.comment: We have been running this non-stop since we got it. Air quality is not something that you can see so I just went with the model Consumer Reports recommended.

B0BG3L9JKH.title: Works good! reduses odor and dust
B0BG3L9JKH.comment: Works great I have had it running for 3 weeks and I noticed a reduction of dust and it smells cleaner in my place. I run it on med high setting its a little loud at that setting but I'm used to it.

B0BG3L9JKH.title: Very good air cleaner
B0BG3L9JKH.comment: My son's apartment at college had a few nasty odors from room mates' old food and the lack of cleaning typical of many college students. I purchased this air filter for him and when I returned a few days later, all odors were gone and the rooms smelled clean again. Great product.

B0C3FCZ93G.title: works great
B0C3FCZ93G.comment: i use it to quickly dry my basement that floods

B0C3FCZ93G.title: Good fan
B0C3FCZ93G.comment: Bought these to use on my deck to keep mosquitos away. They move a lot of air, I like the front facing control.

B0C3FCZ93G.title: Powerful fan
B0C3FCZ93G.comment: I set this fan up in front of an open master bedroom window. I placed a quiet tower fan at the foot of my bed, set to oscillate. Together, they kept me cool and comfortable on hot summer nights without AC.

B0C3FCZ93G.title: Buy it for the summer!
B0C3FCZ93G.comment: I'm glad that I brought Lasko! It was so easy to put together and never need tool. The noise is a little to loud but I don't care. It keep my house cool.

B0C3FCZ93G.title: This is perfect..
B0C3FCZ93G.comment: Wanted a loud fan to drown out noises at night. This is perfect...loud enough even on level 1. Very powerful too.

B0C3FCZ93G.title: Wind, wind!
B0C3FCZ93G.comment: Very fast delivery. This fan is very powerful for its price! I use it on patio, and several times in the apartment! Strong wind for a small space!

B0C3FCZ93G.title: It blows air and lots of it.
B0C3FCZ93G.comment: It would be nice if it had a lower setting. Even on low this thing blows air and makes quite a bit of noise. On low, it is at a decent ambient level that creates a comfortable white noise that blocks out the outside noise. On high, it is pretty loud. Its not a bad sound, but its like being on an airplane. This fan is simple and metal which is kind of retro. Its not bad at a floor level, but probably best mounted.

B0C3FCZ93G.title: Air circulation
B0C3FCZ93G.comment: I have had this fan for a few days and so far is working fine. The high level really blows strong; I usually run it on medium on my screen porch. I would recommend at this point.

B0BBK42NXG.title: Easy but temp calibration is extremely off as in 7 degrees but they're easy to use space heaters
B0BBK42NXG.comment: One thing you need to beware of never plug a space heater into a power strip or Tower and I like the Simplicity of this space heater, I had one from two years ago so I ordered three more because I'm strategizing to cut cost i n a very drafty apartment but I am disappointed that the new ones, which are white, not silver by the way, have a bad calibration just like the old one. If you don't mind the flashing blue light on top when it's running you'll like it, but set it for the temperature below what you need. It does have a good oscillating feature that's not noisy. Set it for 65 not 70 or for 70 not 75 or you will roast like a turkey in an oven.

B0BBK42NXG.title: Effective; expensive to operate
B0BBK42NXG.comment: I purchased one of these in late 2019 because my wife smokes on our screened in patio and it can get pretty nippy in central Florida that time of year. It still works, and it definitely pumps out some heat. These days on colder nights we set it against the screen to keep our feral cat colony warm. As some others have noted, this will definitely jack up your electric bill, so use it sparingly - especially if you are not using it in an enclosed space. I subtracted a star for that. Otherwise, it does its job and ours is going on eighteen months old and continues to be reliable.

B0BBK42NXG.title: Great value!
B0BBK42NXG.comment: This worked great in our basement bedroom! It was so warm we had to turn it off!!

B0BBK42NXG.title: Very effective. One warning.
B0BBK42NXG.comment: Live everything about this heater which more than got me through a few days of a broken furnace in Chicago area. Really heats a whole room if you leave it on long enough. Only drawback is if it tips over the heater does not shut off automatically like most newer space heaters do.

B0BBK42NXG.title: quiet and efficient
B0BBK42NXG.comment: I use this in a 200ish square foot room. It is the sole source of heat for that room. Winters around here hover around 40F. It heats the room quietly with efficiency. It oscillates which helps spread the heat more evenly and the digital thermostat makes it easy to set up. It does not run that often and has been great on the electric bill. I am buying a second one for another room since this one has been so good.

B0BBK42NXG.title: Love the rotation
B0BBK42NXG.comment: I use this on my backporch when the weather is cold.

B083JY6NDY.title: Awesome
B083JY6NDY.comment: It's totally wonderful and works for exactly what I needed.

B083JY6NDY.title: Improved DeLonghi oil filled radiator
B083JY6NDY.comment: This DeLonghi radiator is an improvement on an already very good product. This updated version heats up quickly and has additional safety features. Aside from the automatic shutoff, the heater itself gets hot but not as dangerously hot as the heaters of the past. It runs quietly and can be set to a specific temperature.

B083JY6NDY.title: This is amazing. My S
B083JY6NDY.comment: This is amazing. My S.O. got one for his art studio, which doesn't have heat. It's a huge room and it kept it at a perfect, nice even temp. So I got one for my studio, which is much smaller, but this keeps it at a perfect temp as well. We're so happy with them that my mom bought one for her quilting studio and one for my dad's room on the ranch.

B083JY6NDY.title: Click,click,click,click,click....will it ever stop?
B083JY6NDY.comment: This thing I guess heats ok sometimes but mine has a problem with its thermostat. It stays 4 degrees higher that its set at, and it absolutely NEVER stops clicking...half the time its heating I get random loud annoying clicks. Far from quiet . I cant sleep with this in the room. If this does not get better ...it's going back. This seems to be a common complaint.

B083JY6NDY.title: Short lived, low heat
B083JY6NDY.comment: This heater broke not long after purchase! And honestly it didn’t put out as much heat as my other cheaper area heaters from Target.

B083JY6NDY.title: Toasty warm, no worry like most heaters.
B083JY6NDY.comment: This heater is perfect. Easy to set temperature. Timer too! No flames or hot spots to burn human or animal(I have dogs). Very efficiently & I have lowered my heating bill.

B083JY6NDY.title: This is an updated model of their very reliable oil filled heater.
B083JY6NDY.comment: We use this unit for an unheated bedroom addition. It replaced the previous model we used for years. Since there is no exposed heating elements we feel it is the safest method available (about the same risk as an electric hot water heater). This new model heats faster and has more advanced airflow. So far we are impressed.

B083JY6NDY.title: takes a long time to heat up room. I got a cheaper one that worked better.
B083JY6NDY.comment: takes a long time to heat up room. I got a cheaper one that is better.

B0BGRHX51N.title: Can’t beat original!
B0BGRHX51N.comment: Every day jeans that wear forever.

B0BGRHX51N.title: veteran 501 wearer
B0BGRHX51N.comment: I've been wearing 501's for many years and enjoy the jeans. It seems to me that the past few pairs that I have bought have had buttonholes that were too small for the buttons. Wish they would measure that more carefullu.

B0BGRHX51N.title: Exactly what I ordered
B0BGRHX51N.comment: Exactly what I ordered. I would re-order these again

B0BGRHX51N.title: Levi's and they button.
B0BGRHX51N.comment: These were for a mechanic. What can you say? He said "they fit, they button up, they are what I asked for". He washed them twice to shrink them down and seems to be happy with them.

B0BGRHX51N.title: Love 501s but these didn't fit at all.
B0BGRHX51N.comment: Love 501s but these didn't fit at all.

B0BGRHX51N.title: Nice besides few issues
B0BGRHX51N.comment: Bought it for my husband who is 5'6" and 160 lbs and wears 32-33 inch waist and 29 inch length . Bought size 33Wx29L . Length is perfect but tight in the waist . Plus then he tried it on and struggle with button front instead of zipper I decided its not a good fit for him . Would buy it with zipper and size up . I like the fit and color overall .

B08YDWZ3C3.title: I love these Gildan shirts!
B08YDWZ3C3.comment: Over the past couple of years I've ordered probably a half dozen of these shirts. They are a great weight, resist pilling, keep their shape and their color. Can't recommend them highly enough.

B08YDWZ3C3.title: Gildan = Quality
B08YDWZ3C3.comment: Gildan is my go to brand for my business!!

B08YDWZ3C3.title: Comfy fit, have to SEW the armpits on them though
B08YDWZ3C3.comment: Comfortable fit. They always have huge threads at the armpit and it pulls open the seam at the armpit so you will have to SEW all of these shirts, when you get them. That must be why they're so inexpensive for cotton shirts.

B08YDWZ3C3.title: Very bright color! Good quality fabric. Well made. True to size.
B08YDWZ3C3.comment: Nice medium weight t-shirt. Good fit. Washes up well. Color is more like "day-glow" than a muted shade.

B08YDWZ3C3.title: Decent shirt.
B08YDWZ3C3.comment: I ordered this to go with a gift for Christmas. When it came, one of the shirts had a dark stain on the upper front left side. I didn’t have time to return and get another, so I only gave one of the shirts as a gift (it came in a package of 2). Other than that they seem like ok shirts.

B08YDWZ3C3.title: Not as advertised
B08YDWZ3C3.comment: ok, but advertised as cotton t shirts but is only 35% Cotton.

B08YDWZ3C3.title: Gildan Men's Heavy Cotton Adult T-shirt, 2 pack
B08YDWZ3C3.comment: Even after washing to get it ready for wear, the shirts came out stiff and not very comfortable. The color was OK, but I would not get these shirts again. Not easy to move in b/c not "breatheable." OK to wear when doing heavy household jobs though.

B0BGRJ1JTZ.title: Amazing!
B0BGRJ1JTZ.comment: I am very picky about my jeans. So it takes me a long time to find a pair I like. I have already purchased 3 pairs of these, I love them that much. Since it takes a while for me to find some I like, I buy extra for back up pairs. My weight has fluctuated lately and these have held up perfectly.

B0BGRJ1JTZ.title: Great fit
B0BGRJ1JTZ.comment: I like the way it conforms to your body movements. It fits and looks great

B0BGRJ1JTZ.title: A little bigger than what I expected.
B0BGRJ1JTZ.comment: They are a little bigger than what I had expected, but I still wear them for work. I will order a 32 instead of a 34 next time.

B0BGRJ1JTZ.title: The perfect jean for my hubby
B0BGRJ1JTZ.comment: Hubby is a stylish 64 year old but was looking for more comfort in his jeans. I ordered these as they have some stretch to them and thought they would feel better in the waist. HE LOVES THEM! Comfy and dressy enough to wear to dinner with a nice casual shirt. I LOVE THEM because they are not baggy "old man" jeans. They have a more contemporary fit with a slightly slimmer cut to the leg. He gets him comfort and I get to see him in a nice, better fitting jean...his "tush" looks great in these! :-)

B0BGRJ1JTZ.title: Great jeans
B0BGRJ1JTZ.comment: There is nothing to dislike, these are the most comfortable pair of Levi’s I’ve ever owned fit perfect. I was a little worried buying clothes without trying them on first especially jeans, I lucked out I guess.

B0BGRJ1JTZ.title: Great pants
B0BGRJ1JTZ.comment: Needed to hem these, but I knew that when I purchased them. This series by Levi is my favorite.

B0BGRJ1JTZ.title: A second choice to wheat jeans
B0BGRJ1JTZ.comment: I loved wheat jeans. I recall them from many years ago. They were a bit whiter than the Chinchilla color and they were as heavy as regular denim jeans. These are a lighter fabric. Having said that, these are a good pant. I like the slight fashion up-tick from jeans and the color is ok.

B0BGRJ1JTZ.title: Not much stretch in these jeans.
B0BGRJ1JTZ.comment: I have another pair of these and they fit great. I've been fighting this pair for some stretch and they are winning. They're so tight at the waist that I'm afraid that the button is going to shoot off and hurt someone.

B07BNXNH2D.title: Shirt review
B07BNXNH2D.comment: These are my husbands favorite shirts.

B07BNXNH2D.title: Order Smaller
B07BNXNH2D.comment: I like these shirts very much, but before I ordered them, I read the comments, and several people mentioned that that they were bigger than the size tag indicated. B09GY7VLTV.title: Doesn't charge
B09GY7VLTV.comment: Received charger and it had 38 percent battery life remaining. Tested out on my phone, charged it from 41% to 53% I. Less than ten minutes, taking the battery pack down to 34 percent battery life. Great right? Well, I put it on the type c charger cable provided and left it overnight. It only got up to 51%, so it definitely does not charge itself in two hours. Switched to a micro USB to see if that will take it up to 100. But jf getting it charged is this timely and complicated I will have to send it back. Looks nice and feels nice, display is easy to read.

B09GY7VLTV.title: Never worry about laptop going dead!
B09GY7VLTV.comment: Love Love LOVE that I can carry this little guy around and always have a full charge for my laptop! It's great peace of mind when I'm out in places without power. My laptop is going dead, but I don't have to worry; I can just plug this guy in & keep right on working! Extra benefit of charging my phone multiple times, as well. Nothing ever stays charged long enough! Wish it was lighter, but I'm not going to complain!

B09GY7VLTV.title: Back me up
B09GY7VLTV.comment: Great for charging all my devices when I'm on the go. Works great for the laptop and other devices.

B09GY7VLTV.title: Quite heavy backup
B09GY7VLTV.comment: I liked the size but it was quite a bit heavier than my prior backup battery. It also came with a cord with a lightning connection on both ends. That means carrying an additional adapter. I plan to try something else.

B09GY7VLTV.title: Good but heqvy
B09GY7VLTV.comment: This works ok but it’s case is slippery and hard to grip. Quite heavy too.

B087J367SP.title: It works!
B087J367SP.comment: This is a simple product. It works to charge my headphones in a decent amount of time.. It has a blue light that indicates when it is charging. It is a little bit bulky is otherwise a great product.

B087J367SP.title: very reliable and fast charge
B087J367SP.comment: got for iPad air 3rd generation and it works flawlessly.

B087J367SP.title: Works great
B087J367SP.comment: It charges my stuff, works amazingly

B087J367SP.title: Decent, basic charge cube, USB-C only
B087J367SP.comment: Nice charging cube. I like the rounded design of the corners and the flip-out spades of the plug. Feels well built and seems like it will last. Charges my phone normally and we'll. To be clear, the end of the charging wire going into the charger must be USB-C, and you will need to buy one if those separately. This unit does not come with a wire.

B087J367SP.title: Compact and dependable--not to mention convenient.
B087J367SP.comment: This is the second charging station I’ve owned. The first one had 8 plugs and I was very disappointed with it. It was slow as molasses. Even though I was using good quality cords (not those colored cords you get at the dollar store or the Target checkout) it would take its sweet time to charge even one device at a time. Not so with this one. I can have four devices going at a time and the percentage indicator on all progresses at a fast clip. I don’t own any C-type devices, so I can’t speak for the top plug, but the four USB plugs work wonderfully whether charging with lightning cords or micro. Of course, as I hinted above, the quality of the charging cord you’re using is a contributor.…

B087J367SP.title: Solid Brick.
B087J367SP.comment: I use it to charge my S8, Dell XPS 15 9570, and galaxy buds when I'm at work. Solid charger. Been using for a couple of months, no issues.

B0BVV4GRNV.title: 1 star
B0BVV4GRNV.comment: I absolutely despise every single thing about this "charger." For starters, it only actually charges your phone like 25% of the time. It constantly loses the connection and many mornings I woke up to a completely dead phone. The Speaker is also terrible. I wouldn't spend my money on this product when there are so many more to choose from that are amazing.

B0BVV4GRNV.title: Perfect
B0BVV4GRNV.comment: Great charging stand. Light is very small and does not interfere with sleeping. Works perfectly bwithy Pixel 6 Pro.

B0BVV4GRNV.title: Slow Charging
B0BVV4GRNV.comment: It causes my phone to heat up and charges very slowly.

B0BVV4GRNV.title: Price is right
B0BVV4GRNV.comment: Work great on our note phones

B0BVV4GRNV.title: Works great on iPhone SE 2020
B0BVV4GRNV.comment: Purchased for my granddaughter. She says it works great and is glad she can charge it in landscape view if she wants to watch something while it is charging.

B0BVV4GRNV.title: Nice combo.
B0BVV4GRNV.comment: I love using this charger/speaker for my night stand. It connects very easily via Bluetooth. The speaker has a nice lower volume range for somethng that will be by your head. Not for use if you need a loud speaker. It is clear sounding. I love that even in pitch black it is easy to set my phone on and charges well.

B0BVV4GRNV.title: Almost perfect
B0BVV4GRNV.comment: Very well built and attractive stand. The charger can be used in portrait and landscape mode and my phone is sturdy both ways. Another plus is that the stand comes with the wall charger as well so you don't have to buy one. This would almost be a perfect product, but the charger uses a outdated micro USB slot to connect to the wall charger. Would be perfect if it used USB-C.

B0BVV4GRNV.title: Usually stops charging in the night and I wake up with a partially charged phone
B0BVV4GRNV.comment: Set an alarm to wake up in the middle of the night. Unplug the charger and plug it back in. Then hopefully your phone will be more than 27% charged when you wake up!

B0BS41534F.title: Starting to like INIU products
B0BS41534F.comment: I spoke too soon, USB C port no longer working after a little over two months of service. During my use, it also has the tendency to slide out from the cigarette lighter socket and if you don’t check, you end up with a dead phone after you exited your car. Such a waste and I am now outside return window. There goes my $$ down the drain, literally. Original review with 5 star: Anker used to be my go to brand when it comes to phone charging accessories but lately, their product is over priced and quality degraded. I now purchased the INIU power bank, used it 3 times to charge my phone and still have half a charge so I’m completely satisfied. Now I need to replace my broken plastic Anker car…

B0BS41534F.title: Does what it says.
B0BS41534F.comment: I wish I could get one of these that was dual-usbc. My car has two dash ports, and it would be useful. That said, it does what it’s supposed to, and was cheap.

B0BS41534F.title: Not consistent
B0BS41534F.comment: When it works, it's amazingly fast, however sometimes it takes 15 minutes to put enough current into the phone to charge it. My phone will actually lose power (in terms of percentage) a bit before the charging kicks in. The first one was replaced for a connectivity issue. You get what you pay for. I'll look for something better.

B0BS41534F.title: Doesn't stay in contact
B0BS41534F.comment: The plug end doesn't stay in contact and with the slightest movement will disconnect from power. I have to push it all the way in and carefully not disturb it for it to keep working. My other similar plug works fine. Otherwise good product.

B0BS41534F.title: The electronics inside are great, the springs though...
B0BS41534F.comment: This charger provides a fast charge to my Samsung Galaxy S9, and the voltage display is easy to read. The only thing I would change are the springs. The one at the tip is too strong and the ones at the sides are too weak, so the charger tends to push itself out of contact with the port from time to time.

B0BS41534F.title: Fast!
B0BS41534F.comment: Small and fast. Not sure if the battery gage works with great accuracy, but that's not why I bought it lol.

B0BS41534F.title: Works great but hard to read volts
B0BS41534F.comment: Overall, I'm happy with this charger. The one thing I'm not happy about it the volt meter display is dimmer than expected. So it is hard to read. I'm using this in the galley of my teardrop trailer to monitor the battery. Way better than not having it, but I wish it was brighter & easier to read. I would buy again if there wasn't a brighter option available. USB charger ports are fine. Good to have both USB C & USB A ports.

B0BS41534F.title: Can't see it during the day
B0BS41534F.comment: And will not stay seated in some sockets. Too short and gets fat sooner than it should. But the display is a deal breaker. Has to be dark to see it.

B0B17SFVC9.title: Perfect. Quality as expected
B0B17SFVC9.comment: Apple Watch and iPhone. Fast charge. Love it.

B0B17SFVC9.title: Charged
B0B17SFVC9.comment: Charges fast and perfect for my iPhone and mini ipad

B0B17SFVC9.title: silver, not white as shown
B0B17SFVC9.comment: I returned the first one, thinking it was a mistake, when i received silver, not white as shown. Received the same silver version when i ordered a replacement. I have one from last year and wanted them to match. Oh, well. Works well, never fails, charges both my iPhone SE and iPad SE quickly, folds down for travel, and a great discounted price for its features.

B0B17SFVC9.title: It is not fast charger
B0B17SFVC9.comment: It is not fast charger and is not any better than any other charger on 1/2 price.

B0B17SFVC9.title: Legit
B0B17SFVC9.comment: How do I know if this charger is legit? It just came with a bag not a box. I might return it.
